CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2579 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 632d2fe261b5293e718363485cd816909bf3290c. Bus nonce: d190b84d1b9c6093eadae293bb02a765. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 632d2fe261b5293e718363485cd816909bf3290c`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 632d2fe261b5293e718363485cd816909bf3290c` or `Fix review: blocked 632d2fe261b5293e718363485cd816909bf3290c <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: d190b84d1b9c6093eadae293bb02a765`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `632d2fe261b5293e718363485cd816909bf3290c` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2579 632d2fe261b5293e718363485cd816909bf3290c") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2579-d190b84d`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
RE-REVIEW, round 7, ADVERSARIAL, of PR #2579 (group R10-FLOW-YIELD-PROBE, branch fix/r10-flow-yield-probe) at head 632d2fe261b5293e718363485cd816909bf3290c. The fixer's round-7 code is 8a01caf2e, merged onto the PR by update_pr.sh. Round 6 was BLOCKED; read it with `git fetch origin review/2579 && git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md` (commit f7a6bdf0c). The round-6 reviewer recommended no further split and named the minimal mergeable part: this PR plus two edits. Check exactly those, and do not re-open settled ground. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
1. The probe-slice survivor is dead. Apply the mutants `nonce[:8]` -> `nonce[-8:]` and `nonce[:8]` -> `nonce[8:16]` in review_strength.py's `load` yourself. Each must fail the self-test. The unmutated self-test passes, and its check count matches the body.
2. Re-run `dev/audit/harnesses/r10_review_strength_mutants.py --jobs 4`. It must show undisposed=0 and stale=0, and every figure the body states must match.
3. The GROUP_RE disposition carries no stale count.
4. `## Forward-carry` cites the two guardrail points as landed by the orchestrator on R10-ORCH-MACHINERY. Check that they are in the group's carry at origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster.
5. `## Red checks` names every red in the branch history (check-runs API). `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head>` is clean. `carry_audit.py check --body` gives 0 unrouted and 0 bad.
This is round 7. Return merge unless a required item fails.
Time box 45 min.
